orientationSource.use: A-H identity and rotation/reflection constraints only

familyReview: Each family and source-specific variant was retained as a separate reviewed template. Similar-looking sheets were not merged solely by appearance; topology, core, room labels and inset differences were checked.

registration.method: Existing local WGS84 ellipsoid east/north metre frame; symmetric boundary sampling, ICP/Chamfer refinement, Powell similarity fit; both handedness candidates evaluated
registration.officialGeometry: data/laguna-tower-1/court-query.raw.json, exact BuildingNameEN match per tower
registration.cameraClearance: All camera proxies outside the matched official polygon; facade discrepancy <= 2m; outward normal selected from room-side witness

notes: All 38 official BuildingCSUID values were selected from the saved estate-level LandsD response; no new broad dataset download was used.
Floor ranges and vertical height models remain separate from horizontal geometry and retain their source-specific uncertainty.
needs-review.json is empty because every current registration passed deterministic geometry and semantic orientation QA.
